headRevision.semantics: informational only; not the measured runtime or harness identity

harnessHeadRevision.semantics: informational commit containing or preceding the working-tree harness content

generatedRuntimeAssets.comparison: exact file bytes and sizes match accepted before baseline manifest

acceptedGeneratedAssetBaseline.semantics: accepted generated runtime asset baseline pair loaded from immutable report blobs at sourceCommit

provenance.runtimeVerification: git diff and untracked-file checks against declared runtime revision passed before resource creation

identityProof.method: authenticated HTTP nonce plus Linux listener inode/process-tree proof

input.semantics: empirical user-interaction distribution clustered within five independent browser samples
input.convergenceSemantics: WebSocket send timestamp to the first successful current-trial xterm buffer observation; xterm drain is reported separately

instrumentationSemantics.wrapperDurations: Synchronous wrapper elapsed times are instrumented upper bounds that include the original handler call and measurement overhead
instrumentationSemantics.firstVisible: First successful current-trial xterm buffer observation; it is not substituted with a later terminal.write callback
instrumentationSemantics.xtermDrain: Callback for the production xterm write carrying the trial token; reported separately and may precede the polling observation
instrumentationSemantics.productionOutputBoundary: The matching pending-write flush when present, otherwise the matching real direct terminal.write call used by cold/full-screen output
